name: Pasión de Gavilanes
description: The Reyes-Elizondo's idyllic lives are shattered by a murder charge against Eric and León.

videos.title: Bernardo and Libia are lovers
videos.overview: Town gossip spreads of young Libia's secret romance with a rich older man, while her brother Franco woos a dive bar singer with a speedy side job.

videos.title: The discovery
videos.overview: A new circumstance leads the Reyes brothers to agree on Libia's future. Norma recalls a traumatic event. Fernando plots to force Bernardo's hand.

videos.title: Bernardo's fate
videos.overview: Libia hears in town what happens to Bernardo. Hortencia convinces Libia to go to the Elizando ranch. There, she meets with disaster.

videos.title: Libia's tragedy
videos.overview: Libia makes a desperate decision. Gabriela finds Libia's photo. Fernando makes plans to live alone with Norma. The Reyes brothers learn Bernardo lied.

videos.title: The Reyes brothers at the Elizondo ranch
videos.overview: The Reyes brothers learn what happened the night Libia visited the Elizondo ranch. Resentful Eva sees an opportunity to get revenge against Gabriela.

videos.title: The new workers
videos.overview: The Reyes brothers infiltrate the Elizondo household under a false cover. Rosario refuses to give up her lifestyle for Franco. Jimena seeks attention.

videos.title: An eye for an eye
videos.overview: Oscar proposes a revenge plan to Juan that won't land them in jail. Gabriela returns from her trip and meets the new workers. Juan sets eyes on Norma.

videos.title: Seducing the Elizondos
videos.overview: The Reyes brothers pursue their first target. Eva has a change of heart. Armando threatens Franco. Franco accuses Oscar of having an ulterior motive.

videos.title: The first approaches
videos.overview: Norma is unsettled by Juan. Eva recalls her painful past. Gabriela confesses a regret to Eva. Jimena secretly meets Franco away from the ranch.

videos.title: A big heart
videos.overview: Rosario bans Franco from the bar. Gabriela has plans for Jimena and Sarita involving the Uribes' nephews. Juan wins Norma's admiration.

videos.title: Franco is injured
videos.overview: Franco suffers grave consequences of ignoring Armando's warning. Juan and Oscar argue over an offer of help, and later confront Rosario at the bar.

videos.title: For the Elizondo fortune
videos.overview: The Uribes' nephews become frequent guests at the ranch. The Reyes brothers add a member to their household. A mishap brings Juan and Norma closer.

videos.title: Alcala Bar
videos.overview: Jimena and Sarita go on a date with the Uribes' nephews. Juan's words make Norma wonder. Rosario feels the backlash of cutting ties with Armando.

videos.title: Accomplices
videos.overview: Norma confesses her feeling for Juan to Eva. Franco gets revenge for being attacked. Jimena makes a startling announcement at the dinner table.

videos.title: Awakened Instincts
videos.overview: Eva voices her concerns about Juan to Norma. The Reyes brothers receive an unexpected visitor at their home. Jimena uses her ticket to freedom.

videos.title: Oscar's Plans
videos.overview: Armando asks Fernando for a favor. Raquel and Gabriela set a deadline. Norma arranges a rendezvous with Juan, and sets a firm boundary with Fernando.

videos.title: Jimena's Promise
videos.overview: Jimena makes a promise to Franco. An upset Eva drops a bombshell on the Elizondo family. Sarita becomes suspicious of Norma. Jimena has an awakening.

videos.title: Leandro's Shamelessness
videos.overview: Leandro follows Jimena to find out who her secret boyfriend is. Gabriela upsets Eva with a special request. Ruth's arrival shocks the Reyes brothers.

videos.title: Ruth's Presence
videos.overview: Eva disobeys Gabriela. Norma and Juan take a big risk. Fernando follows a family member's bad advice. One of the Reyes brothers catches Ruth's eye.

videos.title: Fernando's Desperation
videos.overview: Rosario returns to work at Alcala Bar. Norma asks for a divorce. Fernando takes desperate measures to win Norma's sympathy. Ruth makes Oscar nervous.

videos.title: The History of Libia
videos.overview: Oscar reluctantly agrees to go out with Ruth. Jimena is miffed after being abandoned during a date. To Franco's dismay, Armando gets a lucky break.

videos.title: Between Jimena and Rosario
videos.overview: Juan makes a scene in front of the Elizondo family. Jimena executes a calculated revenge plan. Fernando puts Norma on the spot at the dinner table.

videos.title: Eva approaches Ruth
videos.overview: Armando puts up a false front. A case of mistaken identity lands two innocents in a grim situation. Another witness catches Juan and Norma together.

videos.title: The Alcala Bar owner
videos.overview: After being questioned, Armando gets an unpleasant surprise. The Reyes brothers and the Elizondos are brought closer together by their shared crisis.

videos.title: A night in the dessert
videos.overview: A distraught Gabriela seeks comfort from her father. Jimena gets to know Oscar, who recalls a painful time in his youth, and finds unexpected stardom.

videos.title: Jimena's Return
videos.overview: The Elizondos commit an oversight. A dinner with Ruth becomes emotional for the Reyes brothers. A palm reader at a carnival predicts Juan's future.

videos.title: Accept me as I am
videos.overview: Franco and Rosario argue over her boundaries of her job duties. Oscar goes an eerie outing with Ruth. Juan shows Norma the reality of his life.

videos.title: Norma's surprise
videos.overview: The Elizondos learn what's wrong with Norma. Armando tries to make Rosario jealous. Norma is pressured to stay married. Jimena gives Oscar a test.

videos.title: A new singer
videos.overview: Norma asks Eva to give a letter to Juan. Ruth's curiosity is piqued when Juan calls her Libia. Armando employs a new tactic to get Rosario back.

videos.title: The key is the commercial
videos.overview: In Santa Clara, Norma witnesses a shocking scene that brings her to a decision about her future. Rosario is frustrated with Franco's lack of ambition.

videos.title: The Divorce Decision
videos.overview: Norma makes a choice between duty and love. Armando's manipulations affect Rosario. Leandro tells Jimena of Ruth's close relationship with Óscar.

videos.title: Gateway to Commitment
videos.overview: Óscar puts his foot down over Jimena's wedding. Juan decides to face reality and force the Elizondos to do the same. Gabriela and Sarita hava a scare.

videos.title: The Cottage
videos.overview: Óscar and Jimena set a careful plan in motion. Sarita becomes suspicious and investigates. The Elizondos demand an explanation from Juan and Franco.

videos.title: Óscar and Jimena's Big Day
videos.overview: Gabriela and Sarita coerce Jimena and Óscar into returning to the ranch. Rosario learns Armando gave Pepita a ring. Juan threatens to disown Óscar.

videos.title: Dealing With Jimena
videos.overview: Gabriela decides what to do about Jimena and Óscar. Juan prepares to reopen the bakery. Pancha warns Franco he's in danger of losing Rosario

videos.title: A Life Change
videos.overview: Óscar asks Franco to make a sacrifice. Tensions between Rosario and Pepita boil over. Jimena has a rough first night. Rosario gets a job offer.

videos.title: I'm Not Accustomed to This
videos.overview: Jimena finds a note with strangely familiar handwriting. Ruth asks Leandro for a favor on behalf of Óscar. Rosario issues Franco an ultimatum

videos.title: Daughter's Rescue
videos.overview: After hearing horrifying gossip about Jimena and Óscar, Gabriela takes action. A turn of events brings Norma and Juan face to face.

videos.title: Norma's Secret
videos.overview: Jimena decides where she wants to live. Juan and Norma can no longer hide their feelings. Fernando overhears a name, and comes clean to Gabriela.

videos.title: Norma Leaves the Ranch
videos.overview: Gabriela begs Fernando not to move out of the ranch. Norma takes up a new residence. Eduvina pays Franco a visit at the fruit stand.

videos.title: Franco's Strategy
videos.overview: Franco contacts Eduvina. Norma goes to the Reyes home for a dinner date. Gabriela's social life suffers. Raquel demands that Leandor fire Óscar.

videos.title: Private Secretary
videos.overview: After setting some ground rules with his new employer, Franco accepts an unusual, high-visibility job, and later comes home to a surprise.

videos.title: The Photograph
videos.overview: Increasingly obsessive, Eduvina gives Franco an expensive gift. Jimena overhears a troubling conversation and later stumbles upon a shocking find.

videos.title: The Fate of Libia Reyes
videos.overview: Jimena chats with Hortencia at the fruit stand. Eduvina orchestrates an awkward encounter at a party and later visits Alcalá Bar alone.

videos.title: Dinner and Poison
videos.overview: Jimena overhears a terrifying conversation and later takes drastic measures in self-defense. Franco stumbles upon a shocking scene.

videos.title: Oscar's Close Call
videos.overview: Franco returns to the Reyes home. Desperately worried over Jimena and Norma's disappearance, Emilce goes to the Elizondo ranch.

videos.title: Denouncing the Reyes Brothers
videos.overview: Martin thinks he knows who Eva's child is. Gabriela, Sarita and a gun-toting Fernando rush to the Reyes home in search of Jimena and Norma.

videos.title: Eva's Revenge
videos.overview: Ruth finds out who Libia was. Eva is fired, but she soon gets a new job. After learning where Jimena and Norma are, the Reyes brothers rush there.

videos.title: The Reyes Brothers are Thrown Out on the Street
videos.overview: Herzog and Rubinsky visit the Reyes home. After witnessing a heartbreaking scene, Franco is given a chance to turn around his family's misfortune.

videos.title: Franco's Fortune
videos.overview: Juan and Oscar threaten to disown Franco if he goes through with his plans. The Elizondos and Uribes receive a shocking invitation.

videos.title: Eduvina Goes Berserk
videos.overview: Eva is stunned to see Franco at her workplace. Eduvina refuses to follow her doctor's orders. A turn of events casts suspicion on the Reyes brothers.

videos.title: The Mistreatment
videos.overview: The Reyes brothers lose Ruth's trust. An overwhelmed Franco allows himself to be mistreated. Eva seeks help from Juan and Óscar.

videos.title: The Reyes Brothers at Trueba Ranch
videos.overview: Jimena gets a job offer. Eva visits Ruth. Franco begs Juan and Oscar to help him manage his fortune. Fernando brings Pepita to the Elizondo ranch.

videos.title: Change of Luck
videos.overview: During the next year, the Reyes brothers settle into their new home and roles, Rosario's career soars and Norma gives birth.

videos.title: Landowners Meeting
videos.overview: Juan sees an opportunity to get closer to Norma. Fernando meets Norma's baby. Fernando says he's over Rosario. Jimena shows Ruth photos of Libia.

videos.title: Falling at the Fence
videos.overview: Sarita meets the Elizondos' new neighbors. An accident brings Sarita to the Reyes ranch. The Reyes brothers receive an invitation to a party.

videos.title: A Party for the Reyes Brothers
videos.overview: The Reyes brothers meet with the Elizondos to discuss property lines. Norma threatens to move out again. Sarita attends the Rosales family's party.

videos.title: Juan's Child
videos.overview: Juan meets his son. Rosario admits marital problems to Pancha. Leandro asks Oscar for help. Gabriela loses faith in Sarita's ability to run the ranch.

videos.title: All For Love
videos.overview: Pancha tells Rosario about Franco's new life. Dínora pays Juan a visit. Everyone forgets Martín's birthday -- except for Pepita.

videos.title: The Truth About Ruth
videos.overview: Manolo and Miguel ask Oscar for a job. Ruth defies her mother and starts working for Leandro. Juan gives his son a gift, which Gabriela later spots.

videos.title: The Medallion
videos.overview: At the party, Rosario tries to provoke Franco, which infuriates Armando. A scare brings Norma closer to Juan. Oscar finds Eva's photo of her child.

videos.title: TV Commerical Heartthrob
videos.overview: Dínora corners Juan. Fernando starts working at the Elizondo ranch. Rosario pays Franco a surprise visit. Óscar asks Bruno Ferraño for a favor.

videos.title: TV Commercial Kiss
videos.overview: Calixto tells Ruth that Raquel isn't her mom. Norma decides on a name for the baby. Jimena gets a shock while filming a new commercial.

videos.title: The Baptism
videos.overview: Norma invites the Reyes brothers to the baptism. Martín goes on an outing with Pepita. At Gabriela's request, Fernando invites Dinora to the ranch.

videos.title: Together Forever
videos.overview: Franco pays Sarita a compliment. Rosario pursues Franco more aggressively. Gabriela offers Dínora an alliance. Jimena is tricked into meeting Oscar.

videos.title: An Attack Against Franco
videos.overview: Armando sees an opportunity to put an end to Franco. Óscar decides to test a theory he has about Eva. Juan trespasses in order to see Norma.

videos.title: Love Attack
videos.overview: At the party, Ruth pulls Eva aside, Jimena and Óscar try to make each other jealous and Franco makes a bold move. Meanwhile, Norma reaches her limit.

videos.title: Franco's Rescue
videos.overview: Oscar winds up in a mortifying situation. Sarita is forced to show Franco how much she cares for him. Armando is made to look like a fool.

videos.title: Jimena's Revenge
videos.overview: Sarita receives a heartfelt thank-you. Oscar goes to the Elizondo ranch. Norma arranges to meet Juan to tell him something, but Dínora interferes.

videos.title: False Accusations
videos.overview: Dínora and Gabriela plant doubts about Juan in Norma's mind. Franco sets things straight with Armando. Dínora lies to Juan about Norma's intentions.

videos.title: The Elizondo Sisters Go on the Defense
Norma Wants to Live with Juan
Beyond a Threat
videos.overview: The Reyes Elizondo family is troubled by a murder charge against their twin children.

videos.title: After the Enemy
videos.overview: Eric and Leon Reyes are willing to risk everything to discover who is blackmailing them.

videos.title: Endangered Love
videos.overview: Juan and Norma confront each other; Óscar Reyes discovers one of the secrets his nephews are hiding.

videos.title: A Passion in Stakes
videos.overview: When she gets her first face-to-face meeting with Juan David Reyes, Rosario Montes drops her guard.

videos.title: Ultimatum
videos.overview: Óscar Reyes is summoned by the police; he is being charge with obstruction of justice.

videos.title: A Hunch
videos.overview: Juan is willing to use violence to get the truth from the twins.

videos.title: A Storm from the Past
videos.overview: Sara Elizondo explodes with jealousy when Rosario Montes hires Sara's son at Bar Alcalá.

videos.title: Victim of Manipulation
videos.overview: Romina uses her son to demand money from Óscar; a secret turns into a time bomb.

videos.title: Burning Desire
videos.overview: Rosario wants to seduce Juan David; he can't imagine what she has in store for him.

videos.title: Where Is Adela?
videos.overview: Félix Carreño has a nervous breakdown when Juan Reyes asks him about Adela.

videos.title: Reyes Under Attack
videos.overview: The Reyes’ lives are in danger because of a clash; Rosario gets tired of waiting for Juan David.
